name_zh: 梅尔/以色列/铁娘子/战争/定居点/诺贝尔/安萨尔/耶路撒冷
description_zh: 戈德哈玛·梅尔 (1898-1995) 是以色列著名的女政治家和总理，享有"铁娘子"的称号。她领导以色列进行一系列战争，包括独立战争和六日战争等，推行定居点政策，加强以色列国防力量，赢得诺贝尔和平奖，并推动安沙尔计划等。
description_en: Golda Meir (1898-1995) was a famous female politician and Prime Minister of Israel, known as the "Iron Lady". She led Israel in a series of wars including independence war and six-day war, implemented settlement policy, strengthened Israel's defense capabilities, won the Nobel Peace Prize, and promoted Anchar program etc.
reason_zh: 核心思维：M535(铁娘子/战争领袖/定居点/诺贝尔/梅尔主义)、1(战略预判)、67(战略敏捷)、37(知行合一)、153(儒商传承/民族建设)。梅尔体现了战略预判和知行合一的精神，通过战争领袖身份实现国家建设，通过定居点政策加强国防力量，通过诺贝尔奖提升国际地位，通过安沙尔计划实现民族复兴。
reason_en: Core thinking modes: M535(Iron Lady/War Leader/Settlements/Nobel/Meirism)、1(Strategic Foresight)、67(Strategic Agility)、37(Know-Act Integration)、153(Ju-Shang Inheritance/Nation Building)。Meir embodies strategic foresight and know-act integration spirit through war leader identity achieving national construction, settlement policy strengthening defense capabilities, Nobel Prize enhancing international status, Anchar program realizing national revival.
steps_zh: 第1步：战略预判法——制定战争大计：制定独立战争和六日战争计划
第2步：战略敏捷法——灵活战争：通过战争行动实现国家建设
第3步：知行合一——实施战争战略：通过政治努力和战争实践实现国家建设
第4步：儒商传承——民族建设：继承民族智慧，建设现代国家
第5步：长期主义——维护国家：确保以色列的长期发展和安全
steps_en: Step 1: Strategic Foresight - Formulate war plan: Formulate independence war and six-day war plan
Step 2: Strategic Agility - Flexible war: Achieve national construction through war actions
Step 3: Know-Act Integration - Implement war strategy: Realize national construction through political efforts and war practice
Step 4: Ju-Shang Inheritance - National construction: Inherit national wisdom, build modern nation
Step 5: Long-termism - Maintain nation: Ensure Israel's long-term development and security
expected_zh: 推动以色列的独立和生存
提升以色列的国际地位
case_zh: 1898 出生；1948 建国；1995 逝世；战争/诺贝尔奖。铁娘子/战争领袖/定居点/诺贝尔/安沙尔范式永存。
case_en: 1898 birth; 1948 state-building; 1995 death; war/Nobel Prize. Iron Lady/War Leader/Settlements/Nobel/Anchar paradigm endures.
